LOCAL LEGAL SERVICES

Digby & Clare

Legal services from Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko for clients in this region. Appointments in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

The local picture

Digby’s courthouse serves Digby and Annapolis Counties. For residents of Clare and neighbouring rural communities, identifying the court office before planning a trip helps avoid confusing a hearing location with a filing destination.

Prepare for the conversation

For an inherited home or rural property, gather the ownership documents and any questions about shared access. Tell the practice your preferred appointment language; appointments are offered in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

Arrange your appointment

The practice is based in Halifax and welcomes enquiries from throughout Nova Scotia. Include your community, the practice area and any deadlines. Availability and the scope of representation are confirmed after an initial conversation and conflict check.
